newsitem.title: JAPAN: Two Japanese firms to join China cement venture.
newsitem.headline: Two Japanese firms to join China cement venture.

text.p: Mitsubishi Materials Corp and Nihon Cement Co Ltd said they would sign a contract to jointly invest in a Chinese cement venture later on Monday.

The venture, Hainan Yuhuan Cement Ltd, is located in southern China's Hainan Province and is currently owned by China's Xingxing Engineering Construction and Real Estate Development Corp, and two British companies, Asinco Ltd and Great Eastern Investment Ltd, the Japanese companies said in a statement.
After the Japanese companies' investment, the venture's name will be changed to Hainan Kunlun Cement Enterprise Co Ltd, and its capitalisation will rise to $11.4 million, the statement said.
Mitsubishi Materials and Xingxing will each own 26.3 percent of the venture, Nihon Cement 21 percent, Asinco 17.5 percent and Great Eastern 8.7 percent, it said.
The company will make ordinary cement and mixed cement at a total annual production rate of 450,000 tonnes from later this year, the statement said.
Annual sales are expected to hit $29 million in five years, it said.
The cement products will be sold locally and exported to neighbouring countries, including Vietnam and the Philippines, the statement said.
